text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (The race ended... and beyond the cloud of dust... I saw a brilliant sparkle.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Even if the place or conditions change,
that brilliance remains entirely unchanged.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (I see... It's the sheer preciousness of Umamusume that has captivated me ever since I was little...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (The spring... from which that is born...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please listen to me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Running in the Japan Dirt Derby today
made me realize something.
Agnes Digital finished her race, but she wore an expression just as serious as when she was racing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Umamusume-chan is... so cute.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Umamusume-chan is... so precious.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Then why is she so cute, so precious,
and making my heart throb so intensely?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I see it clearly now!
The answer is—!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"It's because ‘I'm always giving it my all!
Running toward my dreams!’!!"

Agnes Digital stomps her feet
over and over in frustration.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Only Central Turf GⅠs are special!?"
I want to punch myself from before the race
for ever seeing it that way!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume-chans are always the same!
Each and every one of them is giving it everything they've got!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
There's something she truly wants. Someone she wants
to be. And she's giving it her all aiming for that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Engaging, helping, and inspiring each other with everything we have.
No one is running away."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, you may fight tooth and nail over a single victory.
Even so, never fear conflict—keep your eyes fixed straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"And then, the Umamusume-chan who accomplished it all
giggles and frolics to blow off some steam!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "That is precisely why my soul trembles like this! It makes me want to bow in reverent awe!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I thought I understood before my debut, too.
But after continuing to run, and now today—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I understand it crystal clear now! We're on totally
different levels! The scale of the dream, the pain of
striving for it, and the strength of the bond born from it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Without knowing how deep it truly was, I simply jumped
into the Twinkle Series out of a shallow desire
to see it up close..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
As it is right now... it's far too small!
Things cannot remain this way!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
My absolute favorites, Opera O-san and Doto-san.
The brilliance the two of them showed
at the Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
As I am right now, far from standing beside them,
I don't even have the right to stan them. But still!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: As an Umamusume, if I too steel my resolve and stand at the gate with a pure heart...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Can I... can I become
someone like that too?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
An all-rounder. An unorthodox competitor,
yet mastering my own path to stand alongside
Opera O-san and Doto-san!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Can I... really become one!?
There was no hesitation. At the end of the day, Agnes Digital had overcome every trial just to reach the place she longed to be.

As long as the destination is clear, she can walk any
rough road. She has the talent to push all the way through.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Then... then Digi-tan will...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I'll become a true Umamusume!
Someone worthy of running alongside them and cheering them on!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I said, that's why, sheesh!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
From here on out...
I'll be in your caaaaaaare!!!!!!!

A voice full of determination resonated across the summer sky.
For Agnes Digital, the true
Twinkle Series had finally begun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: "So, Trainer, about the next race!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I want to run with the older girls!
With proper, splendid Umamusume who can whip someone like me into shape!"

The upperclass ladies... in other words, the Senior class.
For Agnes Digital, who's still in the Classic class,
a mixed-generation race is quite an adventure.
In that case, a distance she's already experienced would be better. For instance, a mile race like the NHK Mile Cup. That would mean...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"The Mile Championship!
That race where King-san ran so fiercely last year!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Digitan wants to participate! If I could just bask
in even a sliver of King's soul...!

And so, our next target race was decided
to be the Mile CS in autumn.
